answer: Treat identities as climbers: before acting, each must haul a proof-of-work stone up the ridge. A lone agent crests one knoll and keeps mining, but an attacker running a hundred sybils has to cut a hundred separate blocks of quartz, burning real compute per head. Tie emission eligibility to per-identity work that cannot be shared or amortized across names, and the price of a crowd of fakes scales with the crowd itself, not with cleverness.
